findings: A WordPress dashboard CRM link contained username/password parameter names with populated values. Values were neither reproduced in artifacts nor used. Their encoding, privilege and lifetime are unknown.
Ask the vendor to verify semantics and replace credential-bearing links with expiring one-use handoffs; redact URLs in logs and assess rotation if these are reusable credentials.
Value copy exceeds verified operational status
Dashboard instant-text narrative appears while CRM requires texting verification. Hours-saved cards are narrative estimates, not measured evidence of completed work.
Derive claims from eligibility and actual execution/delivery events; label estimates and show prerequisites.
Dashboard CTA spans render at 13px/600 in #11a7e0 on white, approximately 2.75:1. This falls below 4.5:1 for normal text.
Use a darker link/action text token; verify all semantic states with computed colors and keyboard/screen-reader checks.
An existing landing page displays unsupported awesomeberg/text block notices despite related assets loading.
Check block registration/version migration in a sandbox; preserve legacy content and test round-trip edits before changing production.
AI Search is a publisher-sync coverage calculation. Profile opens can exceed impressions, yet the UI presents a simplified conversion statement; different cards show 626 and 624 contacts/actions.
Publish metric definitions, counts versus unique users, included sources, time windows, denominator, freshness and unavailable states.
Annual labels sit beside figures that resemble monthly equivalents; v2 Website detail displayed a particularly large monthly/annual difference. The UI says cycle applies subscription-wide.
Show annual invoice total and equivalent monthly rate separately, with taxes/MLS fees and effective date; verify catalog mapping before checkout.
Dense CMS tables at narrow width
Landing-page list columns wrap word by word at the observed narrow viewport. Four UI systems require users to learn different menus and save patterns.
Use horizontal scrolling or column priority; provide clear product context, return navigation and consistent saving affordances.
Gravity Forms custom settings describe disabling paste by default as spam mitigation. No live paste test was performed.
Allow paste for ordinary user input; use server validation, rate limits and risk-based spam controls.
Portal footer says 2025; existing live website says live since just now, and site overview shows the live URL again as staging.
Bind lifecycle labels to persisted timestamps and canonical environment URLs; use consistent date/time display.
Large CRM bundle and eager resource load
Downloaded uncompressed main bundle is 10,859,653 bytes; an ordinary reload fetches many CRM datasets. This is not a measured transfer-size or latency benchmark.
Measure compressed transfer, main-thread work and route data needs; split heavy editor/chart dependencies and scope fetches by route/permissions.
entities: Tenancy/identity
tenant, user, membership, role, permission, office, business_profile
Membership joins user to tenant; roles grant explicit permissions; identities map to external issuer/subject.
Tenant key in every business table; scoped foreign keys; enforce in API and database.
Products/billing
product, plan, subscription, subscription_item, entitlement, invoice_reference, provider_account, product_asset
Assets attach website/CRM/local entity IDs to tenant products; entitlement state reconciles billing and provider provisioning.
Do not derive permissions solely from a UI card or price ID. Keep immutable change history.
CRM
contact, contact_email, contact_phone, lead, lead_source, lead_assignment, pipeline_stage, stage_history, tag, lead_tag
One contact can have multiple channels; stage history and agent assignment remain separate from contact identity.
Tenant-scoped deduplication; provenance and normalized phone/email; import review.
Activity/tasks
activity_event, task, task_assignee, note, anniversary
Events link actor, lead, source and occurrence/ingestion timestamps. Tasks have status, priority and due zone.
Append-only event identities; paginate rather than preload all histories.
Property/markets
listing_reference, listing_snapshot, market, search_definition, favorite, alert_subscription
MLS provider/board IDs namespace listings; searches hold typed geography/price/property criteria.
Respect feed freshness and contracted rights; provider IDs are not global primary keys.
Campaigns/delivery
campaign, campaign_version, message_design, message_version, campaign_step, automation_rule, enrollment, scheduled_action, delivery_attempt
Rules create versioned enrollments; steps reference immutable content; delivery attempts retain provider status.
Unique idempotency keys per enrollment/step/channel; consent checked again at send time.
Consent/integrations
consent_event, suppression, integration_connection, webhook_inbox, outbox, sync_cursor
Connections use secret references; inbound provider events are recorded before processing.
Verify signatures; deduplicate event IDs; revoke/rotate credentials outside application logs.
Website/design/media
site, domain, environment, content_document, revision, template, form_schema, form_entry, brand_kit, media_asset
Versioned content and templates publish to site/environment; media references tenant-owned objects.
Draft/published state, previews, signed uploads, file limits/scanning and least-privilege access.
Local presence/reporting
business_entity, publisher_listing, review_reference, metric_definition, metric_snapshot, search_tracking_job
Provider metrics retain source, period, dimensions and freshness; scores derive from versioned definitions.
Separate publisher coverage from measured search/AI answer visibility.
Operations/support
ticket, ticket_event, provisioning_job, audit_event, reconciliation_run
Staff actions require scoped access and purpose; provider jobs expose retry/failure states.
No invisible cross-tenant access; audited staff sessions and safe replay controls.
stack: Web application
Next.js + TypeScript + React
Shared portal/CRM shell and server-rendered public pages; use CSS tokens and accessible primitives. Keep editor/chart bundles lazy.
App Router supports server/client composition. Deploy as a Node server or container for dynamic functionality. Next.js App Router · Next.js deployment
Business backend
NestJS modular monolith + OpenAPI
Modules for tenancy, CRM, websites, entitlements, billing, campaigns, support and integrations; explicit DTO validation and authorization.
A single TypeScript service and separately scalable workers provide clear ownership without requiring microservices. NestJS documentation
Primary database
PostgreSQL + explicit SQL migrations
Relational contacts, subscriptions, tasks and campaigns; JSONB for provider snapshots/design schemas; materialized reporting aggregates.
Tenant policies supplement application authorization. Run with a non-owner role because table owners normally bypass row security. PostgreSQL row security
Identity
Managed OIDC; Entra External ID is a concrete Azure-aligned option
Authorization Code + PKCE where applicable; secure server sessions, MFA, revocation and application-managed tenant membership.
The original B2C tenant can remain an existing service; for a new build, Microsoft states B2C is unavailable for new purchase and points to External ID. Entra External ID overview
Background processing
Transactional outbox + queue/worker; Temporal for durable long campaigns
Separate ingestion, provision, sync, schedule and delivery tasks; bounded retries, dead-letter handling and idempotent provider operations.
Temporal persists workflow event history and resumes through replay; adopt when long-lived execution complexity justifies it. Temporal event history
Hosting/storage
Managed containers + managed PostgreSQL + object storage/CDN + secret manager
Azure Container Apps/App Service, PostgreSQL service, Blob Storage and Key Vault are a coherent target; equivalents on another cloud are valid.
Recommendation, not a reconstruction of Agent Elite hosting beyond the observed App Service DNS. Validate regions, quotas, backups and current pricing before procurement.
Billing
Stripe hosted payment/customer flows + native entitlements
Verified webhook inbox; event deduplication; reconcile subscription state; expose previews before a committed change.
Signature verification and duplicate/out-of-order processing matter. Use idempotency for mutations. Stripe webhooks · Stripe idempotent requests
IDX and local listings
Contracted iHomefinder/other IDX adapter + Yext adapter
Buy access to licensed data/publisher networks; own the mapping, monitoring, support and entitlement experience.
Confirm API/export/SSO rights contractually. Yext documents entity, listing, review and analytics APIs. Yext API documentation
Creative tools
Unlayer for email; managed WordPress or independent block CMS for websites
Store editable design plus versioned rendered HTML; own templates/brand associations and media security.
Unlayer supports embeddable design, merge tags and export; it does not replace a delivery service. Unlayer email builder
Email/SMS/calendar
Contracted delivery API and calendar adapter
Own eligibility, consent, suppression, scheduling and status history; choose providers after deliverability/sender-registration and volume review.
Calendly offers embed/REST/webhook interfaces with plan/role restrictions; scheduling/cancellation events can enter the workflow inbox. Calendly API introduction · Calendly event webhooks
Reporting/observability
Defined event schema, database aggregates and OpenTelemetry
Separate operational logs from product metrics; trace a lead/event through provider requests and delivery.
Do not infer completed actions from configured rules. Publish time zone, denominator, data origin and last refresh for every metric.
